body:
I gave 7 lines of JS that solves this (hiding the widget).

If we keep adding options like that this has no end.

Problem: when there's a single page I want to hide the pagination widget
Solution: add a new css class with the pages count

Problem: when the user selects a specific facet value I want to hide the refinement list
Solution: add a new css class made of the facet value name currently selected

This do not scale. The particular use case we faced does not need to be adressed with a new API entry, we need to stop adding options like that.

What we are doing here is take data from the results.\* and put it as API entries inside the markup through html structure (here, css classes). There's no added value from taking all the results.\* data and putting it everywhere in the API markup level.

I won't add that just because it's easy to add and we can.
